What changed that allows this to be used, instead of the workaround?

> What changed that allows this to be used, instead of the workaround?

Now chrome/edge/vs/vscode send us the settings when we start debugging.

> Now chrome/edge/vs/vscode send us the settings when we start debugging.

Does this need some minimum version of chrome/edge?

I don't think so, this was a very specific situation where the user set PauseOnException in a tab and open the wasm page in another tab and the setting is not in default value, and we don't receive it.
I prefer to remove at all and if someone complain again about this really specific case, we can ask to update the chrome/edge.
The WBT failure is known, and h related to this pr.
